original_hook: 🚨 Stablecoin wallets challenge traditional bank accounts as main consumer money hub 📰 CoinDesk reports that stablecoin wallets are increasingly challenging traditional bank accounts as primary consumer money hubs. This shift in liquidity architecture directly impacts $BTC. When fiat capital settles natively on-chain, entering and exiting digital assets becomes frictionless. Instead of waiting days for bank wires during market shifts, capital stays parked in stablecoin rails, compressing the time between macro events and liquidity deployment into Bitcoin. With $BTC consolidating around $79,180, on-chain liquidity infrastructure creates faster transmission from fiat to crypto when volatility expands. Bullish, bearish, or wait Which asset is giving the clearest confirmation?
